name: Ater
overview: The name Ater appears in Scripture as a descendant of Hezekiah who returned from Babylonian exile, highlighting the restoration of God's people (Ezra 2:16; Nehemiah 7:21). Additionally, Ater is identified among the porters, entrusted with guarding the temple, demonstrating the community's commitment to holiness and order (Ezra 2:42; Nehemiah 7:45). Furthermore, Ater is listed among those who subscribed to Nehemiah's covenant, reflecting a faithful recommitment to God's covenantal standards after the exile (Nehemiah 10:17).
